name: 129.3 — the census, and :info() stated by category
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 129.3: the three live handles the census marks as carrying :info() -- a gob, an item and a patch -- each answer a table whose keys are the ones their own page lists and no others, with every always-there key present and typed; while a Sub, which the census exempts as a carrier of an ending, refuses :info() naming the two verbs it does answer.
